typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchiveFile as string (),
	ArchivePath as string (),
	Delimiter as string (),
	Emailrecipients as string (),
	EndDate as timestamp (),
	EXEC_STOREDPROC as string (),
	ExportFile as string (),
	ExportPath as string (),
	ExtractType as string (),
	FailureEmailrecipients as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	Getdatepart as string (),
	IsArchive as integer (),
	OverrideFileName as string (),
	SendEmailInd as integer (),
	StartDate as timestamp (),
	StoredProcedureName as string ()
}

source(output(
		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'User::EXEC_STOREDPROC',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> ExecuteStoredProcedure
ExecuteStoredProcedure sink(input(
		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ResultSet)) ~> FlatFileDestination
